decisions.reason: The iOS Requirement already has a complete same-message MODIFY establishing FULL_APP_CONTENT scope, so no addition or edit is needed.
Choosing full-app localization does not independently change the existing requirement for correct RTL rendering in RTL locales.
Expanding localization to full app content does not change the Android application-size optimization goal.
The localization scope decision does not alter the iOS application-size optimization requirement.
Full-app localization has no necessary effect on the policy to remove unused Android permissions.
The decision to localize the full app does not change the existing strategy of serving tutorials and graphics-heavy images remotely.
Localization coverage does not modify Android platform compatibility, deprecated-API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
The full-app localization decision does not change the independent iOS platform-modernization requirement.
Localization scope has no effect on the requirement to provide an iOS Privacy Manifest.
The full-app localization decision does not resolve or change the iOS signing-certificate problem.
The localization scope decision neither resolves the Youku lifecycle ambiguity nor changes its integration behavior.
